archival_memory.research_experience: I've been involved in undergrad research since my sophomore year, which has been an eye-opening experience. It's given me insight into how knowledge is created in the tech world. I initially didn't see myself going down the research route, but a professor noticed my skills in bridging technical coding with user experience and suggested I apply for a research assistant position in a data visualization lab. I was hesitant at first, but it turned out to be a great decision.
